$comment: Metro Vancouver's real-time settings beyond the defaults (config/defaults/rt.json): live dispatch, and the server's port (read from here until the server has config of its own).
$dispatchCheckS: Live dispatch (apps/server/README.md#live-dispatch-and-previews): how often the RT service checks config/regions/metro-vancouver/observations and config/regions/metro-vancouver/disruptions for changes. Only changed inputs re-dispatch a date; client requests never do.
$dispatchWindowDays: Live dispatch covers service dates this many days either side of today; older and later dates come from build:dispatch.
